evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation (39-case shared full-run ensemble, run_all.mjs → results.json); nothing built or flown
verdictSelf: Still NOT credible as an all-conditions product and dominated by towglider on the harmonised ensemble. Redesign v2 fixes the mass/battery basis, launch catch-up, perch tip-over, geofence and footage-model gaps, but the ensemble fails avail (mean 29.9 %), setupTime (p90 60.4 s) and keMax (max 18.0 J in one 6 m/s tailwind run); it is usable only in calm–3 m/s wind for 9–13 m/s riders.

findings.change: Battery from the shared table: 2.0 Wh flying cell at 150 Wh/kg (13.3 g) + 18.5 Wh worn bank recharging the heated flying cell in the sleeve on each 6 min lift (heater 0.6 W charged).

Mass rebuilt from the shared table (124 g incl. 15 % margin: 16 g gyro-logged 4K camera on a 3-axis micro-servo cradle, 1 pusher, no hover motors, no gimbal motor). KE-cap ground speed 14.7 m/s vs 13.0–13.7 m/s rider. Launch catch-up removed: thrown 2–8 s before push-off and the rider waits for a 'ready' vibration; it is airborne behind/above at push-off (catch-up to <10 m: 1.2 s calm).
findings.remaining: Mid-run restarts are not synchronised with the loiter phase: at 3 m/s the glider needs ≈11 s to be within 10 m again. The mass–KE-cap margin is ≈1 m/s; +15 g drops light-wind avail 75→65 %.

findings.change: setupTime/ops now come from all 39 full runs incl. recovery (30 s walk for an off-target landing).
findings.remaining: Even in calm the standstill is 33–35 s: draw 3 s + climb-out to the ready cue ≈8 s + landing wait ≈12 s + side-step + 5 s stow. No palm launch near the face (throw from shoulder, pusher starts after 0.5 s, ≥4.8 m from the helmet).

50 m follow-me geofence with fail-safe landing off the track; landing point 3.5 m beside the rider at the piste-side, not in the lift maze; wind interlock 5.5 m/s (no follow, land) because loiter + wind exceeds the KE cap.
findings.remaining: rangeMax 69.8 m and 18.0 J in one 6 m/s tailwind run where the interlock did not trip; US VLOS and resort bans unchanged (gates).
